store_loader.reads: DECIDED_FRAME (backend/data_delivery/nfl_game_level_features.csv) directly via pd.read_csv — this is the decided-frame loader actually read at serving time; features are built over it with build_features(decided, schedule, pbp).
store_loader.on_disk_at_cutover: NARROW store (1,960 rows, 2019-2025, playoffs INCLUDED, no 2018) — the widened store from db12375 is the committed/on-disk validation CSV, not yet the serving store.
store_loader.where_the_widening_bites: the full-history refit in run_walk_forward. The cutover adds a wide-store GUARD in pull_and_run: a run raises FileNotFoundError when the on-disk frame lacks the 2018 warmup season, so the next pipeline run can never silently train the old pool. Wide-store regeneration is the operational post-commit step (`python3 nfl_game_frame.py` with wide DEFAULT_SEASONS = 2018 warmup + 2019-2025 scored, playoffs stripped).

platt_fit_location.serving_twin: fitted NESTED on the full pooled walk-forward OOF inside run_walk_forward (nfl_moneyline.py) via platt_fit(oof_adaptive_blend, y_po, min_games=PLATT_SEED_FLOOR); PLATT_SEED_FLOOR = 300 is an explicit named constant (identity below 300 games, refit-with-growth from game 301). Never fitted on a holdout, never on the fold being scored. Per-fold nested twins in the fold loop use the same PLATT_SEED_FLOOR convention.
platt_fit_location.seed_floor: PLATT_SEED_FLOOR = 300 present in the serving path (was an inline magic threshold pre-cutover).
